x-existing-contract-extensions.Scope: Preserve existing user/channel conversation scopes. Main-chat knowledge references use live actor ACL; no knowledge conversation scope or canvas chat in this release.

x-semantic-validation: project scope requires project_id; personal/team scope rejects unrelated project_id
object root must have no parent at context resolution; container root must be accessible
all opaque handles bind current actor, execution, root and snapshot; cursor binds query too
knowledge session rejects private or other-container roots
request idempotency includes normalized refs; same key with different refs returns 409
worker cannot bypass current ACL; processing attachments cannot count as fully read
body and knowledge refs are persisted atomically; unknown new-reference fields cannot be silently ignored
object root eligibility: kind topic and parent_id NULL; independent documents remain readable via container root
resolve_context compares supplied roots with the persisted input message; mismatch rejected
top-level reserved actor/org/snapshot/acl inputs are rejected explicitly; legacy unrelated fields keep existing compatibility
navigation parent_id belongs to the selected container; main-chat knowledge roots are independently authorized under existing conversation identity
success responses use existing success/data envelope; error responses use existing error/code/message/details envelope
